Sam Chen: Heads-up — we have a token accounting anomaly for a customer using streaming + tool calls. Dashboard shows a ~1200 token negative delta after a network retry and subsequent truncation. Anyone seen this pattern?

Aria Singh: I saw the alert. Appears when stream is resumed after a transient. We emit partial tokens on chunk flush, then a retry replays tool-call which gets counted again. :thinking_face:

Nina Park: Could be routing fallback too — if the request is routed to a different replica mid-stream we might be double-emitting KV cache warmup tokens + tool-call costs. I grabbed the trace ids.

Miguel Torres: Can you paste a minimal trace + logs? I want to confirm whether the client ack vs server finalization ordering is off.

Sam Chen: Pasting obfuscated logs & events below (stream ids shortened). Note the sequence: START -> emit 400 tokens -> tool_call -> network close -> client retry -> emit 900 tokens -> tool_call. The second tool_call is identical and gets billed.

```
[1779876543] stream_start id=st-abc123 client_conn=42
[1779876544] tokens_emitted id=st-abc123 tokens=400 stage=emit
[1779876546] tool_call id=tc-xx payload_size=1200 billed=true
[1779876547] connection_close id=st-abc123 reason=network
[1779876555] stream_resume id=st-xyz789 new_replica=rep-7
[1779876556] tokens_emitted id=st-xyz789 tokens=900 stage=emit
[1779876557] tool_call id=tc-xx payload_size=1200 billed=true
[1779876559] final_ack id=st-xyz789 total_billed=?
```

Aria Singh: Looks like two independent flow paths both emitting an identical tool_call event. We currently bill tool calls on emission, not finalization. That makes retries replay the bill. Also truncation logic currently credits back tokens only on explicit "finalize/reconcile" which doesn't trigger for network drop.

Nina Park: Proposed short-term fix: dedupe tool_call billing by request id + tool_call id within a 60s window (per-customer). Longer term: change attribution to bill on finalization/ack where possible and show an "in-flight" token bucket in the console.

Miguel Torres: Also need to consider streaming partials: when we truncate due to max_tokens, some customers see extra billed tokens because we counted truncated tokens separately. We should ensure truncation emits a reconcile event that subtracts uncommitted tokens.

Sam Chen: Agreed. Quick action items: add reconcile emit on truncation + ensure router preserves request_id across replica fallback. We might need a small protocol fudge: pass original_request_id in the resume handshake.

Aria Singh: I'll add two metrics to telemetry today: `tokens.emitted.raw`, `tokens.billed.toolcall.dedup_skipped` and a gauge `stream.inflight_tokens` to show partials on the Console timeline. That should make debugging easier.

Nina Park: I'll write an e2e that forces a mid-stream replica swap and a client reconnect to validate no double-charge. I'll also export a query for "negative delta" alerts.

Miguel Torres: I'll update the router to carry `x-origin-id` through fallback. Also will add a short TTL (30s) for dedupe keys in Redis. If we dedupe in the central billing path we need to keep ops aware of dedupe counts in the dashboard.

Sam Chen: Nice. Small UX ask for Console: when a streaming session has unresolved tokens, show a yellow timeline marker and a hover that explains "tokens pending finalization — may be adjusted on reconnect/reconciliation". PLG customers will appreciate the transparency.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Miguel Torres for branch=billing/dedupe at 2026-03-18T18:30:00Z :rocket:

Aria Singh: Putting PR up in a min. Will also add a lightweight migration: backfill dedupe keys from past 1hr of recent tool_call events for affected accounts.

Sam Chen: Thanks — let's triage P0 for the affected customer and keep the alerting on. If anyone sees billing spikes after the deploy pls ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

Nina Park: noted. I'll post the e2e run results here once green.

Miguel Torres: ETA for code changes + canary: 6h. Rollout plan: canary on a single region, monitor `billing.negative_delta` and `tokens.dedupe.count`.

Sam Chen: Great. Assigning: Aria (telemetry + console gauge), Nina (e2e & queries), Miguel (router + dedupe), Sam (customer triage & runbook). Closing thread when canary is stable.
